workouts.name: Neck reset
workouts.instructions: Slowly turn side to side, lower your chin, and lift your gaze within a comfortable range.

guidance.safetyWarning: Move slowly and stay within a comfortable range. Stop if you feel pain or dizziness.

workouts.name: Shoulder reset
workouts.instructions: Release upper-body tension with slow shoulder and shoulder-blade movements.
steps: Draw your shoulder blades gently together
Let your arms hang and release

guidance.safetyWarning: Keep your breathing easy and stop if a movement is uncomfortable.

steps.label: Draw your shoulder blades gently together
Let your arms hang and release

workouts.name: Full-body reset
workouts.instructions: Stand up and move through a short sequence for your sides, legs, and shoulders.
steps: Shake out your arms and settle

guidance.safetyWarning: Use a stable stance and stop if you feel pain, dizziness, or loss of balance.

steps.label: Shake out your arms and settle
